Grid-only items (tournaments, ceremonies, Dojo sessions, karaoke) and standing-room open hours are best-effort reads of the visual grid; verify these against the PDF before relying on exact minutes.

events.title: 50 Years of The Last Dinosaur
events.description: Explore the in-depth production history of the Rankin Bass/Tsuburaya/Toho film The Last Dinosaur. A legendary co-production filled with rubber dinosaurs, Japanese spfx veterans, and "ding dongs." Hosted by Alex Rushdy of Seismic toys.

events.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters Turns 70
events.description: Two years after first appearing in Japan, Godzilla, King of the Monsters made its way to North America. Heavily, but respectfully edited and modified with new actors and sets, the film was a hit and ensured years of further kaiju action Stateside!

events.title: Secrets Of Godzilla 2000
events.description: Uncover the mysteries of Godzilla 2000: Toho's bold reboot in the Millennium era! Our panel reveals the secrets from this Godzilla's origins to the birth of Orga. Explore the fierce suit design, behind-the-scenes trivia, and themes of nature vs. hubris.

events.title: How Marusan's Sofvi Are Made Part 2
events.description: Part 2 of the Marusan factory series goes deeper into sofvi painting with Eiji Kaminaga. Featuring video footage of celebrated toy painter Goto-san, this panel explores the process and artistry that transform vinyl into collectible art.

events.title: Unmade Aurora Kaiju Models
events.description: From 1962 until the mid-1970s, Aurora Models made waves with several lines of monster models. King Kong and Godzilla were the only giant monsters to make it into their original line. Rodan and Ghidrah, designed by artist Dave Cockrum appeared in the "Monsters of the Movies" lineup in the mid-1970s. Cockrum had grand ideas for expanding this model line that never came to pass.

events.title: Akira Ifukube - 20 Years On
events.description: A tribute to Akira Ifukube on the 20th Anniversary of his death - A deep dive into the music of Akira Ifukube: how it defined the Toho films of the 50s, 60s and 90s, and continues to impact the kaiju genre to this day.

events.title: 40 Years of Screen-Used Kaiju Suits and Props
events.description: What happens to the suits and props after a film is finished? I will talk about this, accompanied by a photo tour of the many exhibitions and set visits I have witnessed, showing the suits and props that I have been able to see over the years.

events.title: Gamera vs. Barugon at 60
events.description: A great and entertaining look back at this classic Showa Era movie. Be there to learn about Gamera's first adversary.

events.title: G-Cinema Author Daniel DiManna Interview
events.description: Fresh off the press, G-Cinema: An Exploration and Celebration of Japan's Monster King is the NEWEST book tackling the Big G and his compatriots for their 70 years of history. Podcaster Elijah Thomas interviews author Daniel DiManna about the content of his book and the process behind crafting such a project.

events.title: The Kaiju Gauntlet (The Tallest Kaiju Podcast)
events.description: Audience writes their name on a piece of paper and the panel pulls a name - whoever is chosen gets to go up in front of the crowd and pitch what they think can be the best kaiju film. The panel will take note and at the end decide which idea was the best, with some help from the crowd!

events.title: G-Pardy: Kids Game
events.description: The game made for trivia buffs in the kaiju community, G-Pardy, is back and looking for contestants to test their mental mettle. Kids, here is your game if you think you're a trivia champ of all things kaiju then prove it in this Jeopardy game, G-Pardy!

events.title: Ultraman Unreleased in the US
events.description: Most of the Ultraman franchise has come to North america in recent years, but not everything. This panel will be an overview of titles not yet localized.

events.title: Kaiju Kingdom Podcast
events.description: Presenters discuss Tim Seeley's entire Godzilla series (IDW Godzilla, TMNT X Godzilla, Godzilla-Kai Sei: End of the Reign etc), and his prolific career in comics.

events.title: Kaiju Writers Unite
events.description: Grid-only listing (no printed description). Time approximate; verify against the printed schedule.

events.title: Ultraman Mebius - 20 Years
events.description: A panel discussing the planning for, production of, surrounding merchandise, and impact of Ultraman Mebius alongside companion media pieces ULTRAMAN 2: REQIUEM, Ultraman Mebius & Ultraman Brothers, Ultraman Story 0, Ultraman Fighting Evolution 0, Super 8 Ultra Brothers, etc. in celebration of the show's 20th anniversary.

events.title: I Can't Believe It's Not Godzilla
events.description: A retrospective of different Godzilla-like creatures throughout cinema and literary history.

events.title: Shin Godzilla: 10 Years Later
events.description: In 2016 Toho brought back Godzilla after a 12 year hiatus with one of the largest and most terrifying incarnations at the time. With Hideaki Anno (creator of Neon Genesis Evangelion) at the helm, the movie was not only a big success but reaffirmed the enduring demand for Japanese-made G-films in the West and set the stage for the resurgence of Toho's Godzilla that we've seen in recent years.

events.title: Kaiju On Home Video
events.description: Over the past 50 years, we've gone from being completely unable to own any kaiju movies, to being able to watch them at the click of a button. This panel runs through the complete history of kaiju on home video from VHS to Laserdisc to Streaming and everything in between. Learn about rare, lost, rescued, and "trapped" films & tv shows across all home formats!

events.title: 60th Anniversary: Daimajin
events.description: In 1966, Daiei produced three films following the Mighty Majin of Terror! Kaiju Historians Eliajh Thomas and Daniel DiManna pull back the curtain of this legendary trilogy and break down some of the hidden influences and pieces of history that are as mystic as the Majin himself.

events.title: The Lost World 101
events.description: A celebration of 101 years of one of the prototypical kaiju films, The Lost World (1925), walking through the film's background, plot, and influence. As well, asking whether it's still worth watching today.

events.title: Yonggary 1999: The Best Worst Kaiju Movie of All Time
events.description: In the late 90s, director Shim Hyung-Rae set out to remake Yongary. What was supposed to be the best and biggest movie in the history of South Korean cinema turned out to be nothing short of a train wreck and a textbook example of "So bad, it's good". Join panelists for a retrospective on one of the most infamous kaiju films ever made.

events.title: Bring Your Kaiju Film to Life with VFX
Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker Premiere Public Showing
Introduction to Starting Your Kaiju Zoo (Those Amazing Kaiju Beasts)
events.description: Have you ever considered collecting kaiju figures, re-painting or re-posing them, or building models of them in styrene, vinyl, resin or any other form (there are metal kaiju models!!!) Join the team to discuss the vast universe of kaiju figures & how you can get started creating your very own Kaiju Zoo!

events.title: Learn How to Sculpt with Nick Sparger
events.description: Sculptor and artist Nick Sparger has sculpted original busts for Black Heart models and more. Join him for a hands on introduction to sculpting. Want to re-create kaiju from the Ultraman or Godzilla series, or are you possessed of visions of all new kaiju? It's time to get out there, start to understand sculpting, and bring them to live.

events.title: Kaiju University and Kaiju Village
events.description: NEW FOR 2026! Kaiju University is perfect for those with limited experience who want to build and paint their own model kaiju. Participants receive mentoring from experienced builders, a terrific resin kit, paints, tools, instruction, and supper - all for just $100. Participants MUST pre-register: kaijukastle.org. Kaiju Village is a communal building event for more experienced modellers. Participants bring unbuilt or unfinished models, work together in a maker's space, share techniques, and inspire each other while enjoying the provided meal. Kaiju Village registration (to join the meal): kaijukastle.org

events.title: Young Modellers Make and Take - Ticket Registration (London Room)
events.description: This hands-on workshop lets younger or inexperienced modellers create their own small kaiju bust while learning basic techniques. Get your ticket Friday 10 AM-4 PM in the London Room (one ticket per person, capacity is limited). Arrive 30 minutes before your session start time on Saturday with your ticket to redeem your bust.

events.title: 60 Years of Ultraman
events.description: This year marks the 60th anniversary of Japan's greatest superhero: Ultraman! Each week the Science Patrol and Ultraman fought a different kaiju. It was Must-See TV, and it's still going strong decades later. Come learn about how it all started.

events.title: Guest Interview: Megumi Kobayashi
events.description: Note: the printed description page misprints this as 1:00 PM (which would conflict with the Kohji Moritsugu interview); the schedule grid confirms 2:00 PM.

events.title: 70th Anniversary of Rodan
events.description: Join the author of Godzilla: The First 70 Years as he discusses the first color kaiju film. From the original story to theatrical release in the states, with a bonus look at the recent recreation of the Iwataya Dept Store set.

events.title: Akira Toriyama: The Man, The Myth...The Kaiju Superfan?!?!
events.description: Akira Toriyama is world-famous as the creator of Dragon Ball. People know Goku and Vegeta as well as Superman and Wolverine. But there's a huge side to Toriyama that flies over the head of anime fans. The side that would appeal directly to the G-FEST crowd: The side that was a kaiju-sized fan of giant monster movies. This panel will delve into the many times Akira Toriyama referenced the world of kaiju eiga in his manga over the course of his career, with homages to Ultraman, Gamera, and, of course, the King of the Monsters himself!

events.title: Awards Ceremony & Cosplay Parade
events.description: Room opens 6:45 PM for the Awards Ceremony, followed by the Cosplay Parade.

events.title: G-Pardy: Adults Game
events.description: The game made for trivia buffs in the kaiju community, G-Pardy, is back and looking for contestants to test their mental mettle. Do you dare take up the challenge and aim to bring home the infamous trophy?! Then take your shot in this Jeopardy style game, we welcome all comers!

events.title: Godzilla v. Gene Kelly
events.description: People don't generally think of Godzilla and Gene Kelly at the same time, because they have nothing to do with each other...or do they? Are kaiju fights and dance routines more similar than people realize? Are kaiju movies actually structured like musicals? What about special effects? Take a look at how these two genres actually have a lot in common.

events.title: Kaiju Aesthetic: Tracing the Visual DNA of Giant Monsters
events.description: This panel will provide an overview of the less-discussed intertwining artistic, historical, and theological precedents that led to the birth and visual development of kaiju across media - pre-modern, modern, and post-modern. Areas overviewed will range from the influences of East Asian prehistoric Japanese earthenware (eg. Jomon) and Esoteric Buddhist statuary (eg. Wisdom Kings) to early North american cryptozoology and monster movies and 18th and 19th century European Romanticism.

events.title: Drawing with Matt and Hiroshi
events.description: Join artists Matt Frank and Hiroshi Kanatani as they continue their popular panel series on drawing kaiju by request from the audience, including creating a new kaiju based on fan feedback!

events.title: Q&A with Donald F. Glut
events.description: He's a musician. He's an author. He's a filmmaker. He's a paleontologist. He's the one and only Donald F. Glut! Although he couldn't make it to Chicago this year, he will be appearing live via the internet for a special Q&A panel!

events.title: Otakumerica's Sofubi Crash Course
events.description: Join Otakumerica for a brief introduction to the world of sofubi collecting!

events.title: Collect All Monsters Live
events.description: Hear the tales of toy makers from conception to production. Collect All Monsters showcases the process and the personal perspectives from sofubi slingers in Japan and beyond!

events.title: LIVE STREAM Cosplay Parade Audience Overflow
Gamera vs. Legion Turns 30
events.description: Gamera has returned and is ready to battle Legion. Lots of behind the scenes and information on the movie.

events.title: Cute Godzilla!
events.description: From Chibi to Minya: an exploration of Godzilla's quest to stay culturally relevant.

events.title: The Film Era vs. The Digital Era
events.description: A look at how the shift from film to digital changed the feel of kaiju cinema. Through side-by-side clips, we explore texture, lighting, color, and camera style to reveal the subtle craft changes that reshaped giant monster movies across generations.

events.title: Earliest Kaiju Fiction
events.description: Join professor of Japanese literature Jeffrey Angles and cultural studies scholar Justin Mullis for a wide ranging and exciting discussion of the earliest examples of kaiju prose fiction from both Japan and America.

events.title: European Kaiju Boom of 1961
events.description: You likely know about the "kaiju boom" of the 1960s in Japan, but have you heard of the boom in Europe in 1961? While Toho's Mothra was revolutionizing the genre in Japan, three (in)famous "Euro-kaiju" movies also released that year: Gorgo and Konga in Britain and Reptilicus in Denmark. Panelists take you on a deep dive into these less-than-flattering (but still entertaining) imitators of King Kong and Godzilla.

events.title: The Year of Mothra
events.description: Jessica Tseang, Chris Eaton, and Donny Winter (2025 Eisner winner), celebrate the history of the Queen of the Monsters from her 1961 debut, the Rebirth of Mothra, her unforgettable moments in Godzilla X Kong: New Empire, her future with Legendary, and why she has resonated with so many fans for over 50 years.

events.title: 30th Anniversary of Rebirth of Mothra
events.description: In 1996, with the Godzilla series on hiatus, Toho turned to Mothra to lead a new franchise. Rebirth of Mothra was the first of three films depicting Mothra defending the Earth against various kaiju. Our panelists will discuss this unusual entry in kaiju lore.

events.title: Ultraman Tiga - 30 Years
events.description: A panel discussing the planning for, creation of, reception, and impact of Ultraman Tiga to celebrate its 30th anniversary. Talk about behind the scenes information on Tiga's conception, and its lasting impact on the Ultraman series.

events.title: Understanding Mothra: Cultural, Political, Religious, and Artistic Perspectives
events.description: Toho has proclaimed 2026 "The Year of Mothra! Join panelists as they share their insights and expertise on Mothra. These panelists will offer perspectives on Mothra's origins in literature, reception in Japanese and the U.S. films, and on creating new stories through Mothra comic books and art.

events.title: Cosplay Parade - Greenroom Opens for Contestants
Bringing Kaiju to Life!!! How to Build Kaiju Models
events.description: Join the Team, a panel of experienced modellers for a discussion of all the various ways to build and paint model kaiju so that they look alive on your shelf. Learn the tricks of building resin, vinyl, & styrene giant monsters, and get introduced to some simple painting techniques that make your work look like you're a pro! Whether you've never built a kaiju model or you've been doing it for years, you are guaranteed to learn!

events.title: Adding Color to Kaiju!!! Painting styrene, vinyl, & resin monsters!
events.description: You've learned how to build kits but what about painting them so that you bring them to life. Join The Team to explore the different techniques required for different kinds of model kits, and some easy techniques to improve the look of your unique kaiju kits.

events.title: Adventures in Diorama Building
events.description: Join The Team for an in-depth investigation of how you can create vignettes and dioramas to show off your kaiju models. You already have the command of monster creation, now create the scenes that create scale and drama and vivid life for your models. It's time to let your creations out into a world! Let the destruction begin!

events.title: Japan Wonderfest Trip 2027
events.description: The itinerary has been drafted and for the second time there's an opportunity to tour Japan with a special emphasis on model and toy collecting. Visit the biggest model experience in the world at Winter Wonderfest 2027. Stan will go over the itinerary and how you can participate in this up-coming adventure.

events.title: Meet Model and Monster Master Artist Yuji Kaida
events.description: Some artists are synonymous with the incredible art that attracted us to the model we love. Master artist Yuji Kaida has a long history with fandom, and his incredible art has been featured on model boxes, in magazines, and on movie posters and album covers. Join him for a discussion about his art and his passion for illustrating the incredible.

events.description: Arrive 30 minutes before your session start time with your ticket to redeem your bust. Learn modeling skills with guided instruction and take the finished masterpiece home!

events.title: Films of Kiyotaka Taguchi
events.description: A primer on the filmography of special effects director Kiyotaka Taguchi, including independent works, Ultraman, anime, and more.

events.title: King of the Monster(flicks)
events.description: What is the best kaiju flick? We pit two films against each other and have a champion of each that must make a case for their superiority. The audience decides the winner.

events.title: Godzilla vs. Sea Monster: 60 Years of Lobster Fest
events.description: Tropical islands. Eyepatched terrorists. Giant shrimp. Bank robbers. "Godzilla vs. The Sea Monster" has it all, and it represented a massive tonal and stylistic shift in the Godzilla franchise when it released in 1966. Join the fun as this panel celebrates 60 years of the Red Bamboo, Mothra cameos, and, of course, the one and only Giant Condor.

events.title: Godzilla 1994
events.description: In 1994, Godzilla's Hollywood career was set to kick off with an action-packed blockbuster directed by Jan de Bont. Then, it all came crashing down. How and why did this promising project never materialize? This panel will dive deep into the origins and plot of Godzilla's unmade epic and reveal why it failed to reach cinema screens.

events.title: Gamera Guardian Of The Universe
events.description: Trace the epic evolution of Gamera - from Showa-era "Friend to All Children" in campy battles against Gyaos, Guiron, and more, to the darker Heisei trilogy's Atlantean guardian facing Gyaos, Legion, and Iris. Explore suit designs, practical effects, behind-the-scenes trivia, and the heartfelt Gamera Rebirth. A fiery celebration of this iconic kaiju's birthday bash as he turns 61!!

events.title: War of the Gargantuas: The Frankenstein Brothers Turn 60
events.description: 1966 saw the premiere of War of the Gargantuas, a classic kaiju film whose influence can still be felt in films like Kill Bill and Hot Fuzz. Come hear a panel discussion of this very unusual and enjoyable film.

events.title: Destroy All Rappers - Making a Godzilla Mixtape
events.description: Learn how rapper J-Zilla and producer Tillysteezebeats used the iconic sounds of the Showa Godzilla era soundtracks to craft a nostalgic body of work that fans of kaiju, old school hip-hop, and movie soundtracks will all love.

events.title: Monsterverse and Showa Era
events.description: A deep dive into the similarities between the two eras whilst discussing the polarising fan reactions.

events.title: Tsuburaya but not Ultraman!
events.description: A follow up to last year's successful Ultraman 101 panel. Tsuburaya Productions may be most famous for Ultraman, but has produced all manner of film and television shows over the years. This panel highlights and explores the kaiju and tokusatsu works of the studio that don't star Ultraman, including titles like Gridman, Mighty Jack, Booska and more! Hosted by Seismic Toys' Alex Rushdy.

events.title: The Great Kaiju Hoax of 1947
events.description: In May of 1947, multiple american newspapers reported that a giant sea-monster had recently attacked Tokyo, at least according to a U.S. military radio broadcast. This broadcast would ultimately turn out to be a hoax in the style of Orson Welles' infamous War of the World's broadcast from 1938, but did it influence the creation of Godzilla? Join cultural studies scholar Justin Mullis for an in-depth look at this forgotten episode from kaiju history as well as similar hoaxes in this follow-up to G-FEST 2024's "From Cryptids to Kaiju" and 2025's "From Saucers to Seijin."

events.title: Kaiju Conversation LIVE! 20 Years of Gamera: The Brave
events.description: In 2006, Kadokawa revived the Gamera franchise for a new film. Following the critically acclaimed Gamera Heisei trilogy, this new film faced many challenges in bringing the titanic turtle to new audiences. Unfortunately, the film didn't meet expectations and has now become Gamera's last film. Being designated as just a footnote in the franchise. Hear from the Kaiju Conversation podcast hosts, Elijah Thomas and Jackson Gibbens, alongside fellow podcasters Gratton Conwill and Matthew Fields, as they explore Gamera: The Brave, rediscovering and reevaluating this kaiju classic!

events.title: Kaiju Anime Raids Again
events.description: A look at the many exciting kaiju developments in the anime medium since the previous panel on this topic 9 years ago.

events.title: Mike's House of Monsters G-FEST Special
events.description: What did we buy at G-FEST this year? Join an interactive conversation on the cool stuff we picked up at G-FEST!

events.title: Kaiju Konfessions
events.description: It's time to pack up G-FEST for another year. Join the celebration of Kaiju song and dance! What's a monster movie without a catchy tune? Now it's time to participate in the fun! Join us! Let's SAVE THE EARTH!!!

events.title: One Million Years B.C
events.description: A look back at this Harryhausen classic. Find out how the special effects were achieved.

events.title: Henshin Power V3 LIVE - Ultraman: The Wilderness Years
events.description: The Ultra Series was a pop cultural juggernaut for over a decade, but by 1981, competition with anime and other henshin heroes put the franchise on hiatus. For 15 years, there was no Ultraman on Japanese television. However, the Ultra Heroes weren't idle. Join the hosts of the Henshin Power V3 podcast as they take you through an era of Ultra history that features spinoff series, foreign productions, and a handful of surprising movies.

events.title: Brush of God
events.description: Legendary tokusatsu artist Keizo Murase gifted the world with one last golden egg in the shape of the 2024 film Brush of the God. A film that features the culmination of over 50 years worth of work and a history richer than any other modern kaiju movie. Join the minds behind the NEW Blu-ray release as they discuss this important film to kaiju history.

events.title: BraveStorm - The Forgotten Toku Revival
events.description: In 2017, an ambitious movie landed in Japan: BraveStorm, a reboot of Super Robot Red Baron and Silver Kamen. It could have launched a cinematic universe, but nothing ever came of it. What happened? Is BraveStorm a hidden gem or enjoyably bad? And what could the BraveStorm universe have looked like had it become reality? Ryan Goerge Collins (Omni Viewer, author) and Nathan Marchand (The Monster Island Film Vault, author) will answer these questions and more as they guide you through this forgotten reboot and speculate about what could have been.

events.title: Terry Morse and Godzilla
events.description: This panel explores the how and why of the first Americanized Godzilla film.

events.title: SRS Cinema Kaiju Showcase
events.description: Ron Bonk (President of SRS Cinema) and Elijah Thomas (Bonus Feature Producer) shed some light on the work behind one of the most prolific physical media labels releasing kaiju content. Expect some insider information, tasteful teases, and exclusive announcements.

events.title: Is It a Kaiju?
events.description: This panel explores the boundaries and metric of what defines a kaiju, by exploring other monsters, creatures and more. The goal is to both challenge and expand the idea of what a kaiju is.

events.title: What's the Best Kit of the Year?
events.description: It's been an exciting year for kaiju builders and collectors. There's a renaissance in styrene Godzilla kits exploding on the scene, as well as amazing new vinyl and resin kaiju. Come and joint the Team for an exploration of all that's new and cool. (But be warned, your wallet will be in peril.

events.title: How Can I Find Those Wonderful Kaiju Kits?
events.description: It can be hard finding out where to get rare Japanese (and even American) models and figures of our favourite kaiju. Join the Team for an adventure in...well...kaiju shopping. We'll explore hard-to-find kits as well as let you know about some surprising venues closer to home. Let's find out how you can be 'King of the Kaiju' (collectors)! Model pick up is between 12 PM and 1 PM.

events.title: Where Do Models Come From?
events.description: Join George Stephenson to learn about how the kits we love are produced. George has a long history of providing garage kit builders with incredible kits, from his days creating Geo-Metric models to his current company Black Heart models. He'll explore a variety of production processes (resin, vinyl and 3D printing) and bring samples from those different processes, as well as exploring the positives and negatives of digital sculpting and 3D printing.

events.title: The Wind Up - Model Programming Feedback
events.description: It's been a wild weekend of Godzilla entertainment and hopefully you've made some terrific acquisitions in the dealer's room. Join us to share your discoveries at the convention, talk about what you'd like to see on the tables in the model room (or any special programming) next year, and where the model programming should go from here. In short, did you have a good time, and can we make it better for you next year?
